lid_validation.methodological_finding: Whisper is a monolingual token-per-segment decoder. For mixed speech, it cannot emit a 'mixed' token; it selects the dominant acoustic anchor (<|en|> in all 6 synthetic samples). Claiming 100% LID on mixed speech without a code-switch token class was a methodological overstatement in earlier reports.
